blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Workers can estimate their 13th-month pay by adding their basic salary earnings throughout the year and dividing the total by 12. Workers can estimate their 13th-month bonus by adding their basic salary earnings throughout the year and dividing the total by 12, per Dole’s guidelines. This follows the Department of Labor and Employment’s (Dole) guidelines on the mandatory benefit. The amount does not necessarily equal an employee’s latest monthly salary because the computation considers the total basic salary earned from January to December 2026, including adjustments for unpaid absences and periods when the employee did not work.
